callees.name: validate_base_url
callees.pre_condition: url is a non-empty, whitespace-stripped string.
callees.post_condition: Raises an exception when url is not a syntactically valid absolute URL whose scheme is http or https. Returns with no effect when url is a valid absolute URL with http or https scheme.

callees.name: adapter_for_api_style
callees.post_condition: Raises an exception when style is not a recognized API style identifier. Returns with no effect when style is a recognized API style identifier.
